title: RunDecideParams
description:
`run.decide`'s params (5.1), from an app-role connection only: the app's answer to a
`run.tool_call`. The first answer wins.

rlxd refuses, by error code: `not_gate` from any other connection; `unknown_run`,
`unknown_call`; `already_decided` once the call is decided; `too_late` once its
deadline passed (it was denied `by: "timeout"`).

reason.description: Why, as Claude Code is told (`permissionDecisionReason`).

stop.description: End the run, as `run.needs_you {reason: "denied"}`, once the call is denied.

Decision.description: What a tool call was decided (5.1).

oneOf.description: It doesn't, and the app saved it as a draft (`draft_id`).
